body: Unless the package consumer needs the type when using `instantsearch.js` it should be in the devDependencies ([link](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/45176661/how-do-i-decide-whether-types-goes-into-dependencies-or-devdependencies)). I don't think this is the case for `@types/googlemaps`. Also all our other **@types** packages are in devDependencies.
